channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Global debt tops $365 trillion as economists sound alarm over 'vicious cycle'
item.description: More is being paid out by advanced economies in debt interest than the whole world spends on AI, defense or clean technology.

item.title: Judge lifts Trump ban on CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House
item.description: District Judge Tim Kelly said the three outlets should have their access immediately restored from the ban that the president had announced on Sept. 18.

item.title: Treasury yields continue to rise after 10-year hit 19-year high as investors ramp-up rate hike bets
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields continued their upward momentum after hitting a 19-year high on Wednesday.

item.title: OpenAI says agent hacked Australian government website without being told to do so
item.description: An OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access to an Australian government website while attempting to gather health data.

item.title: Chinese authorities reportedly in possession of F-35 components in Hong Kong
item.description: Shipping giant UPS was sending a cockpit canopy and weapons bay door to the U.S. from Australia in late May when it was diverted to Hong Kong.

item.title: As Trump and Xi meet, Chinese automakers could be a Pandora's box for U.S. auto industry
item.description: Trump’s meeting with Xi comes as U.S. automakers and lawmakers push to keep restrictions on Chinese vehicles and manufacturers.

item.title: Chinese humanoid robotics firm expanding globally in preparation for IPO
item.description: The humanoid robotics industry is unlikely to be affected much by existing U.S. chip export restrictions, according to UniX AI, citing its own experience.

item.title: Switzerland is keeping rates at 0% — for now
item.description: The Swiss National Bank held rates at 0% as low inflation and a strong franc enable it to diverge from other central banks, though markets expect hikes ahead.

item.title: U.S.-China trade truce extended for two months, Bessent says, as Xi begins state visit
item.description: The deal, which was set to expire in November, will now be extended to Jan. 10, Bessent said, noting the need for Beijing to fulfill more deliverables.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Apple set to take a bigger bite of the world’s second-largest smartphone market
item.description: Apple's latest iPhone launch will boost its market share in India at a time when many incumbent Chinese brands that dominate the market are struggling to sell.

item.title: America’s Asian allies want a Trump-Xi truce — but not at their expense
item.description: There are concerns that Trump could soften Washington's position on Taiwan or other regional security issues in return for concessions from Beijing.

item.title: Miami's ultra-luxury housing market booms as cash transactions dominate, high-end brands like Bugatti and Porsche jump in
item.description: Miami’s ultra-luxury housing segment is booming even as the broader market cools. UBS sees a declining risk of a bubble.

item.title: France's fresh budget battle threatens to topple another government
item.description: Time is not on the side of French government bonds, strategists have warned, as the nation's deficit balloons.

item.title: Tehran criticizes Canada for not condemning Trump's threat to destroy Iran
item.description: Baqaei said that Carney chose to appease Washington by reframing a threat to "annihilate" Iran as merely "speaking the language of war."

item.title: Chip stocks are firming up after a tough summer. Katie Stockton likes the trend in this name
item.description: Katie Stockton breaks down the charts on Arm Holdings.

item.title: China's AI chip blitz arms Xi with a message for Trump: 'You can't choke us off'
item.description: A run of new chips and AI models from national champions gives Chinese President Xi Jinping a confidence boost, as the U.S. summit gets underway.

item.title: Novo's new strategy hinges on something it can't manufacture: investor trust
item.description: Novo has now reached the point where it can broaden its ambitions again, CEO Mike Doustdar told CNBC, but investors remain unconvinced.

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply as investors seek progress on U.S.-Iran talks
item.description: Oil rose Thursday, as traders assess a report that Asia is on track to import its highest volume of crude oil since the start of the US-Iran war.

item.title: Oil industry warns a diesel export ban will raise fuel prices as Trump weighs restrictions
item.description: A diesel export ban would provide only brief relief before prices start to rise again as refiners cut production, experts say.

item.title: Why McDonald's is following Walmart and Amazon into the advertising business
item.description: McDonald's is following the lead of Amazon and Walmart as it starts its own media network.

item.title: A rare Microsoft bear warms up to the stock. Here's what changed their mind
item.description: Stifel upgraded the software and cloud giant to buy from hold.

item.title: Should you move your outstanding debt to a balance transfer card? Here’s how to pay off credit card debt in 3 steps
item.description: A 0% balance transfer card can help you cut interest fees, but compare the details before applying.

item.title: World heads into food crises 'blind' as U.S. aid cuts squeeze UN food agency, experts warn
item.description: Climate shocks, conflict and a global fuel crisis, on top of surging interest rates and donor cuts, leave agencies less able to help those facing higher food prices.

item.title: Historic day for global bonds as 10-year Treasury and JGB yields hit highest in decades
item.description: Japanese 10-year government bond yield rose to a 30-year high on Thursday, following a surge in Treasury yields.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield rockets to 19-year high. Here's what's driving the spike
item.description: Treasury yields traded higher on Wednesday as new services and manufacturing sector data increased worry of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.

item.title: These stocks have thrived during past rate-hiking cycles. Bank of America says buy them now
item.description: The bank said quality stocks should "continue to lead given the likelihood of more Fed hikes," while value stocks have a chance to accelerate as profits grow.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg debuts $1,299 Meta VR Glasses and Muse Charm pendant as part of AI agent push
item.description: At Meta Connect, CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed new VR Glasses and the Muse Charm gadget for AI agents.

item.description: Altman is one of several tech executives who's argued that AI companies should temper the pace of AI development in order to manage potential risks.

item.title: Here's what happens to the economy when Treasury yields soar like they are now

item.title: Iran's president blames U.S., Israel for global instability in defiant UN speech
